v0.1.0.description: Initial release ! Refer to the README for all the important information.
v0.1.0.title: 0.1.0-alpha

v0.2.0.description:
## New features
- **Add content from the 0.2.0 update of the game (Scala Moor and Trial of Cryo)**
- Add loactions for Nyx nests and spires, as well as their boss fights.  **The goal also got changed** and currently requires weaving all nests and spires.
- Use separated keys for each dungeon.
- Use separated keys for each dungeon.
- Add deathlink (note: it currently only puts you at 0 health instead of killing you, I'll try to fix it)
- Add in-game options to increase drop/exp gains, enable multi-equipping weapons, and to toggle deathlink

## Bugfixes
- Using a key in Trial of Aether no longer skips the puzzles/fights for the chest that contains the key in vanilla.
- Fix the last fights in **Branching Out** requiring to re-enter the map to trigger.
- Skip the tutorial for Somu's Dream (there is still no content from the roguelite mode in the rando, and it's not planned either for now).
v0.2.0.title: 0.2.0-alpha

v0.2.1.description:
### Changes:
- Game datapackages are now cached instead of downloaded on each connection
- Added cooking ingredients to the pool of filler items
- Chests appear on the map without requiring to go near them beforehand
- Landmark for Lyhamn is activated when starting a new save
### Bugfix:
- Fix the `Cryo.A2` chest not being sent
- Fix the logic for `Plains.SolGate.Puzzle`
- Cooking recipes of swamp are no longer obtained in the cutscene of Training Grounds

v0.2.2.description:
# Warning: there seem to be a crash that occurs when reading the save file. If you play in an async or plan to close the game and continue your save later, you should use the 0.2.1 version instead while I fix the issue.
## New client features (the AP World is still the same as the 0.2.1 version):
- The chests appear on the map all the time. Once seen, the map icon is changed depending on the item classification. The skin of the chest also shows the classification.
- Add a sound effect when receiving an item, depending on its classification.
- Add an option to use fake icons and chest skins (that mimic a progression item) for traps.
- Deathlink now properly sends you back to your last save (this might cause issues, so please report them if something happens !)
